correctness.rationale: The invertible affine transform sends all nine rook neighborhoods bijectively to the nine 4-cycles of K3,3; all K3,3 cycle-matroid closure is generated by 4-cycle completions because every 6-cycle has a chord splitting it into two 4-cycles. Therefore closure equality is proved on all subsets. An extracted independent checker enumerated all 512 sets and found 81 five-element spanning sets and no smaller ones.

value.rationale: Provides an explicit, maximally symmetric four-regular *loopless* realization of the natural boundary graphic matroid M(K3,3), a property not given by the principal paper's looped witness. The affine rectangle identification and 6-cycle chord decomposition explain the closure isomorphism and count all 81 minimum skew forcing sets. This is a natural structural realization problem, not an arbitrary finite slice.
